about: C1's take rule (plan 5(d)), hand-worked: deskd's take_decide (include/deskd/strat/take.h, which says the rule in full) and tools/college_gate.py's decide() must both give every 'want' here, so the gate measures the rule the lane trades. Synthetic games and tickers; no account data.
how: A case's input is base[mode] with the case's 'in' laid over it, and its params are params[mode] with the case's 'params' laid over them: an object is merged key by key (recursively), any other value replaces (null clears it). 'want' is either {'take': {ticker, side, price, count, fee, edge, dir}} or {'pull': CODE, 'edge': the pulled route's edge or null, 'dir': 'A', 'B' or null (the game's own checks)}.
units: Prices and money are the contract's decimal strings in dollars (exactly 4 decimals); sizes are contracts (0.01 steps); times are ms on one clock; game_used and game_cap are dollars; fee_mult is the market's fee_multiplier. A team's price is the ask it buys at, or 1 - the other market's bid it sells at. fee = 0.07 x mult x count x price x (1 - price), rounded up to $0.000001 and then up to the cent (gw/fees.h kalshi_fee_order_cent). edge = fair - price - fee / count, rounded down to $0.0001 for 'want'. A leg's position is the lane's own, signed (YES > 0); sys_position is Systematic's in the market, every lane's, signed, and sys_buying and sys_selling what is left of its working orders there on each side; inventory is the lane's limit a market, in contracts (gw's SYS_CEILING inventory). A route's count is also at most max(inventory, |x|) - x - w, in whole steps, where x is the market sent to's sys_position for a BUY (-sys_position for a SELL) and w its sys_buying (sys_selling): none, and the route stops at INVENTORY, after GAME_CAP and before CLIP.

cases.name: inventory_full
cases.note: C1 holds 20 of A, its limit: BUY A has no room. A has no bid and B no touch (NO_TOUCH, an earlier check), so A's BUY is the route that got furthest.

cases.name: reducing_past_the_limit
cases.note: C1 short 30 of A, past its 20 (a limit lowered since, say). Buying A reduces it, and gw lets an order end as far from flat as the position began: max(20, 30) + 30 = 60 (to 30 long; 61 would be refused). A $50 clip and no game cap leave the room to bind: 60 at 0.45, fee 1.04 (1.0395), edge 0.25 - 1.04 / 60 = 0.2326. SELL B: the 10 at its bid, edge 0.22 - 0.018 = 0.2020.
